newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS rates Canadian Natural paper program.
newsitem.headline: CBRS rates Canadian Natural paper program.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Thursday it assigned an A-1 rating to Canadian Natural Resources Ltd's commercial paper program.
Canadian Natural has an authorized C$200 million program supported by committed bank lines.
CBRS said the rating reflected a high degree of liquidity support provided by strong and growing cash flow and additional backing from the bank credit facilities.

"Additionally, the demonstrated history of rapid production growth, low costs and consistently strong profit performance are positive features supporting the credit risk of these short term debt instruments," CBRS said.

It said Canadian Natural's acquisition of Sceptre Resources in mid-1996 was a big step in the company's growth plans, adding significantly to production and providing exploration and development prospects.

Canadian Natural's undeveloped land base of 4.1 million acres was one of the top five inventories in the Canadian industry and translated into several years of exploration and production opportunities, CBRS said.

It said the company's 1997 production was expected to maintain the rapid growth rates exhibited in the first nine months of last year through vigorous field activity and possible property acquisitions.
